messages:
rajan: Noticed a customer report where provisional token counts spike in the console after a streaming session that fell back mid-request. final billing shows tokens moved back to original route after reconciliation. suspect header loss during handoff.

emily: do you have the session id? can we correlate with router traces?

rajan: sess-0xabc123. gist of logs: proxy accepted on ap-southeast, runtime truncated at seq 32768, router selected fallback us-east-2, proxy forwarded but X-Route header cleared. runtime retry ran tool_call and emitted provisional ledger entries attributed to us-east-2. 

tom: that explains the console provisional attribution. reconciliation later pulls the host metadata from final runtime billing which still has ap-southeast as owner, so tokens reassign.

ux-alex: From an ops UX view we should distinguish provisional-by-observed-route vs final-reconciled-route and show an explicit "fallback occurred" badge. otherwise support teams chase ghost credits.

emily: quick mitigation: add a proxy check to preserve X-Route if present, and add an assert in our handoff code that route != null. i'll file a router unit test for mid-stream transfer.

tom: ledger side: provisional entries created on retry use a different merchant_tag (tool_search_bg) than primary (search_primary). this breaks our dedupe. propose canonical provisional tag format containing session, original_route, attempt id so reconciliation can match. e.g., "sess-0xabc123|ap-southeast|tool:search|att:2"

rajan: agreed. also emit fallback.meta in provisional ledger (fallback=true, original_route=ap-southeast) so we can query incidents and compute provisional drift.

billing-bot: created BILL-2745 (labels: provisional-drift, routing-fallback) and assigned to billing team.

ux-alex: console changes: (1) add tooltip on provisional totals: "Includes tokens attributed at the time of provisional commit; reconciliations may reassign. Click to view fallback events." (2) add event link that jumps to the handoff trace and shows route header diff.

emily: i'll take the header preservation + router test. tom + billing team can own the ledger tag normalization and fallback flags. ux-alex can spec the console tooltip and the event link.

rajan: repro steps I used: start streaming session to ap-southeast with a tool_call that touches a low-capacity search backend; throttle ap-southeast just after chunk N to force truncation -> router fallback. watch provisional credit show up under fallback route then reconcile. left raw logs in #eng-platform-debug.

tom: one more note for reconciliation window: make sure dedupe tolerates attempt increments and recognizes same logical operation across routes. canonical tag + fallback flag should cover it.

ux-alex: will add a small banner for accounts with >0.5% provisional drift caused by fallback events after this lands.

emily: will submit PR for proxy fix and router test today.

rajan: thanks y'all. leaving the session trace in #eng-platform-debug and pinging billing once tooling lands. :thumbsup:
